title: The promise and peril of Coding & Robotics education in South Africa: A scoping review of teacher preparation and generative artificial intelligence’s potential for delivering equity
extended_summary:
This paper examines how generative artificial intelligence (GenAI) might help address teacher preparation challenges associated with introducing Coding & Robotics (C&R) in South African schools. The central problem is that the new Grades R–9 C&R subject depends on teachers who often lack sufficient pedagogical content knowledge, programming confidence, ongoing professional development, and adequate technological infrastructure in their schools.

The authors conducted a scoping review using Arksey and O’Malley’s framework. They searched ERIC, Google Scholar, IEEE Xplore, and Scopus for peer-reviewed studies published from 2022 to May 2024, screened 221 abstracts, and included 10 studies. The review synthesized evidence from studies involving teachers, learners, and pre-service teachers in school and university contexts, with most evidence drawn from GenAI tools such as ChatGPT, Codex, Copilot, and related LLM-based systems.

Across the reviewed literature, GenAI was found to support teacher learning through personalized pathways, immediate feedback, code generation, lesson-plan feedback, and support for professional learning communities. The paper also reports risks: biased or inaccurate outputs, overreliance on automated assistance, weak prompt specification, and inequities tied to infrastructure and internet access. The authors conclude that GenAI can complement C&R teacher development and resource creation, but only if paired with teacher judgment, quality assurance, ethical guidance, and professional development.

identified_tools.name: GenAI (General)
identified_tools.description: Generative artificial intelligence tools, typically based on large language models, that can generate text/code, provide explanations, feedback, and personalized support.
identified_tools.use_case: This scoping review examined how GenAI could support K–12 Coding & Robotics teacher preparation in South Africa, including lesson-plan feedback, content generation, tutoring, and personalized learning support.

findings.finding_summary: Across 10 included studies, GenAI was reported to help teachers with personalized learning routes, content generation, code explanations, and feedback on lesson plans and teaching methods. The review also notes that tools such as ChatGPT, Codex, and Copilot could support programming practice and reduce workload, but benefits depend on prompts, learning objectives, and teacher verification.
findings.measure: Synthesized findings from included studies on teacher preparation, lesson-plan feedback, code generation, and programming support

quality_tier_rationale: This is a scoping review synthesizing heterogeneous qualitative, mixed-methods, and quasi-experimental studies rather than a single controlled evaluation. The paper does report a systematic search and screening process, but no pooled causal effect estimates are provided.
impact_tier_rationale: The review suggests potentially meaningful benefits for teacher preparation and feedback support, but it provides no effect sizes and the evidence base is indirect and heterogeneous. Reported impacts are promising but remain unclear in magnitude.
